audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits: 53.53% WR over 4930 games, early lane heavily Syndra-favoured (Akali has no safe trade pre-Shroud), difficulty concentrated at 6+ when Perfect Execution's two dashes and Shroud untargetability threaten the all-in.
Spikes right: level 2 QE before her W (20s CD) is learned, level 6 skill window, first-item all-in control. spikes[] has 4 matchup-specific entries.
